podcast.body: The Beatles' debut LP, released in 1963, featured more than half of its tracks written by John Lennon and Paul McCartney. This was an almost unprecedented songwriting achievement for a rock and roll group at the time, though the band had initially honed their craft with cover songs and were fans of R&B girl groups. "When the Beatles debut album Please Please Me arrived in 1963 more than half of its tracks were written by John Lennon and Paul McCartney, a virtually unprecedented achievement for a rock and roll group."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.body: The Beatles' rendition of "Twist and Shout" was released on this album, featuring John Lennon on lead vocals. This particular version of the song has been critically acclaimed as a monumental single take in rock music history. "Their version of Twist and Shout has been called the most famous single take in rock history."
